profile_text.body:
Greylock Partners is a venture capital firm based in Silicon Valley, founded in 1965 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California. The firm describes itself as a leading venture capital firm and as an early partner to remarkable teams building companies that matter. It says each Greylock partner makes only one or two new investments a year because the work demands depth, and that it brings its full attention, network, and resources to every partnership. The site quotes the view that a Greylock partner should aspire to win the Oscar for the best supporting actor, and that this reputation must be earned every day.

The firm's legal exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281. No lawsuits, AI products, or MCP servers are listed for it.
